prompt: Best tri-fold or pocket projector for travel
queries: best portable pocket mini projector for travel 2026
tri-fold portable projector screen or foldable projector travel review
answer:
I didn't find a true "tri-fold" projector. The closest products are compact pocket projectors, and separate fold-up screens. These are the picks the 2026 roundups keep naming. The lumen and battery figures are manufacturer claims, and most of these lists are affiliate-driven.

**Top picks**
- **Best overall for travel: Aurzen Roku TV D1R air.** Pwice tested eight projectors on a 14-day, three-country trip and chose it as editor's choice. It has 300 ANSI lumens, native 1080p and built-in Roku TV ([pwice.com](https://www.pwice.com/best-portable-projectors-for-travel/)).
- **Best picture quality: NEBULA Capsule 3 Laser.** It has a laser light source, 300 ANSI lumens, 1080p and Google TV. It weighs about 2 lb (900 g), so it's bulkier than the others ([ceedo.com](https://www.ceedo.com/best-mini-projector/)).
- **Most pocketable: Sony MP-CD1.** It weighs a little over 0.5 kg and gives up to 105 lumens at full HD. Battery life is about 2 hours, and it's dim, so it needs a dark room ([shopsavvy.com](https://shopsavvy.com/best-picks/top-portable-projectors)).
- **Budget: Magcubic Mini.** It has WiFi 6, Bluetooth 5.4, 4K input support and weighs about 0.88 lb ([pwice.com](https://www.pwice.com/best-portable-projectors-for-travel/)). The Vankyo Leisure 3 is another cheap option, with about 2.5 hours of battery ([shopsavvy.com](https://shopsavvy.com/best-picks/top-portable-projectors)).

**If you want a fold-up screen:** Several 80–150" fabric and tripod screens are sold for travel. Folded fabric screens can arrive creased and need pressing flat. Hotel walls or a white sheet often work well enough, so a screen may not be worth the luggage space ([Newegg listing](https://www.newegg.com/p/0FC-065A-00CF6)). I found no independent tests of them.

**My recommendation:** Get the Aurzen D1R air for general travel. Get the Sony MP-CD1 if size matters more than brightness.
